Geographies Served Programs Gram Hunar Fellowship Programme District Osmanabad Beed State Maharashtra District Osmanabad Beed States Maharashtra The GramHunar Educational Fellowship program aims to support children from grades 1 to 5. Its goal is to address gaps in foundational literacy, numeracy, and life skills. The program also includes components such as social-emotional learning (SEL), engaging with parents, SMCs, teachers, and other community members. Gram Connect Programme District Osmanabad Beed State Maharashtra District Osmanabad Beed States Maharashtra As the name suggests, this program is about connecting the government and citizens. GramUrja works as a bridge agency between these two. We work on awareness, advocacy, enrollment and ensuring entitlements of various government schemes. We work with SC-ST, Migrant, and farm labourer communities under this initiative. To date, we have supported more than 10,000 beneficiaries with this kind of government scheme linkages program. Disaster Relief District Latur Osmanabad Beed State Maharashtra District Latur Osmanabad Beed States Maharashtra Gramurja is actively working in disaster relief and rehabilitation work in disasters such as 1. COVID: PPE kit distribution (more than 2 lakh kits distributed), more than 7000 ration kits distributed. 2. Flood relief: More than 12,000 ration kits distributed. Gram Udyam Programme District Osmanabad Beed State Maharashtra District Osmanabad Beed States Maharashtra Under 'Gram Udyam,' GramUrja Foundation launches diverse initiatives. Introduced in 2021, Entrepreneurship Webinars empower rural youth and women, emphasising career building, financial independence, and Government funding schemes in agro-allied entrepreneurship. We run a three-day Entrepreneurship Development Program(EDP) with budding and willing entrepreneurs from rural areas. After the successful completion of such a workshop, we find potential entrepreneurs with whom we can work in ways of mentorship, seed grant support, marketing, capacity building and others. To date, we have supported more than 120 such entrepreneurs in establishing agro-based and other enterprises. Impact Metrics Baseline and Endline Surveys.
